name: Dify
shortDescription: Open-source platform to build agent workflows visually, with a self-hosted community edition.
longDescription: Dify is a visual platform for agent workflows, with a self-hosted community edition. The cloud free plan includes 200 message credits.
pricingNotes: Self-host Community Edition vs cloud paid.
bestFor: Teams who want a visual agent builder they can self-host
Projects that need a product UI, not only a library
notIdealFor: A small Python script with no surrounding app
Running it on your own computer, which is not described here
strength: There is a self-hosted community edition, and the cloud free plan includes 200 message credits.
weakness: The cloud free plan stops at 200 message credits, and paid pricing is on the Dify site.

useCaseFit.multi-agent-workflows: Visual builder for agent workflows, with a self-hosted community edition.
